tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Regular Proxmint pack prices for each proxy product: pack size, price and price per GB. Packs are prepaid, never expire, and are paid in crypto. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Wallet balance and every product on the account, with its status, bandwidth used and left, and the proxy host, ports and username. The proxy password is left out; generate_proxies returns ready-to-use lines.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Bandwidth and requests per product per UTC day, oldest first, with totals per product. Days with no traffic are left out.

tools.name: generate_proxies
tools.description: Build proxy lines for one product, with optional location targeting and sticky sessions. Rotating lines get a new IP on every request; each sticky line keeps one IP for sticky_minutes (1-120). The lines include the proxy password.

tools.name: check_connection
tools.description: Send one request through a product's proxy and report the exit IP, the country Cloudflare sees it in, and the time taken. Uses a few kilobytes of the product's bandwidth.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
